02 / Bio

A little more about me

I'm Aparna Majety, I'm a Product and Portfolio Associate at ServiceNow. I’m a graduate of the Texas CSB Honors Program, with degrees in Computer Science, Business, and Business Analytics. I am passionate about developing new products and technology solutions that meet the needs of customers. I’m drawn to work where technical rigor meets human needs — whether that’s building a machine learning system, improving a product experience, or finding the story in a messy dataset.

Outside of work, I'm an Indian Classical Dancer, avid film watcher, occasional screen writer, frequent art museum visitor, and overall story telling enthusiast.
